summary: Iteration 8 verified end-to-end: username-based auth + notes on dishes/shopping + full-page shopping editor + toggle-move-to-end + settings edit modals. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests PASSED (backend/tests/test_iteration8.py) covering register validation (too short/spaces/uppercase-normalize/special-chars/mismatch/case-insensitive dup), login case-insensitive + wrong-password 401, PUT /auth/profile (wrong pwd 401, collision 409, success + /me), PUT /auth/password (wrong old 401, same-as-old 422, success + re-login), dish notes create/read, shopping notes add + merge, PATCH name/qty/unit/notes, qty=0 deletes, PATCH rename-into-existing-key merges, toggle checked moves to end, uncheck keeps position, removed endpoints (forgot/reset/session) return 404/405, and /api/export regression. Fixed one CRITICAL backend bug: /api/export raised KeyError('email') because current_user no longer has 'email' after username migration (server.py:804). Frontend: registered fresh user via UI, landed on /planner. Login screen has no Google button and no 'Password dimenticata' link. Register screen has no email field. Piatti dish editor renders testID='dish-notes'. Spesa tab: pressing show-add navigates to /shopping/new (full page with testID shopping-editor + shop-name-input + shop-qty-input + shop-notes-input + shop-save). Pencil edit-<id> visible on row, tap navigates to /shopping/<id>. Notes render as italic sub-text under qty (verified 'fresco intero' visible with icon prefix). Settings shows btn-edit-username + btn-edit-password; both modals (edit-username-modal + edit-password-modal) open and save works; Account card shows current username. One minor: shop-unit-input testID does not exist (unit is a segmented g/kg/ml/pz button group, not a text input) — cosmetic mismatch with spec, functionally fine.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' on load. Non-blocking, unchanged from prior iterations.

'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' — logged once after saving on /shopping/new. Likely from a form/input component. Non-blocking but should be identified before next major upgrade.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If spec requires shop-unit-input testID on a TextInput, refactor the unit selector (currently a segmented button group). Otherwise clarify spec — functional behaviour is fine.
OPTIONAL: Investigate 'element.ref removed in React 19' warning source (likely a third-party form/list lib) before the next React upgrade.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/export: FIXED — was reading current_user['email'] which no longer exists after username migration → 500 KeyError. Changed to {'username': current_user.get('username')}. (server.py:804)
server.py: _norm_username correctly normalizes to lowercase before uniqueness check; case-insensitive duplicate detection works.
server.py toggle_item: correctly sets order = max+1 when checking; leaves order intact when unchecking. Matches spec.
server.py edit_item: rename-into-existing-key branch merges manual_qty, planner_qty, sources, and joins notes with newline — correct behaviour matches spec F.
server.py add_manual: on duplicate key, notes are appended with newline join (only when new notes present) — good.

server.py: server.py is 974 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold from code_review_guidelines. Consider splitting into modules (auth, dishes, planner, shopping, backup) for next major refactor.
updated_files: /app/memory/test_credentials.md (unchanged in this run, but note: legacy email-based creds are obsolete — future testers should register a random username per test run; password must be >=6 chars, password + password_repeat required)
seed_data_creation: Multiple ephemeral users created via /api/auth/register (usernames like 'a<hex>', 'b<hex>', 'e2e<epoch>'). No persistent seed added; expireAfterSeconds index on user_sessions cleans up tokens.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 is complete and passing. Auth is now USERNAME-only (3-30 chars, [a-z0-9_.], case-insensitive). Register requires password_repeat. Endpoints PUT /api/auth/profile (rename username, needs current_password) and PUT /api/auth/password (change pwd, needs old_password) exist. Google/forgot-password/reset-password/session endpoints REMOVED. Dishes and shopping items now have 'notes' fields. Shopping list add/edit is a full-page route: /shopping/new and /shopping/[id] (testID='shopping-editor'). Toggling checked moves item to end of list (order = max+1); unchecking keeps position. Settings has btn-edit-username / btn-edit-password with respective modals. Also fixed pre-existing /api/export KeyError('email') during this run. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8.py; JUnit XML: /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iteration8.xml. Note: the legacy /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py uses old email-based auth and will not run against the new API — either delete it or migrate to usernames.
rca_of_issue: Bug found & fixed: GET /api/export returned 500 KeyError('email'). Root cause: username migration (iteration 8) removed 'email'/'name' fields from the users collection, but export_data still built the response with current_user['email']. Repro: register any user (username-only) → GET /api/export with Bearer token → 500. Fix: replaced payload user block with {'username': current_user.get('username')}. Verified: test_export_ok now passes after backend restart.
